jobs.description:
Feel the authentic. Park Plaza Eindhoven offers 104 stylish rooms and suites in the heart of the City of Light. Within walking distance of Central Station, Van Abbemuseum, and Strijp-S, the hotel is ideal for both business travellers and weekend escapes.

As a Night Front Office Host(ess), you are the face of the hotel during the overnight hours, ensuring a smooth and secure operation while delivering warm, attentive service to our guests. You will manage late arrivals, early departures, and overnight guest requests, while maintaining a calm, organised front desk environment.
This role is key in ensuring guest satisfaction, safety, and operational continuity throughout the night.

The position offers a minimum of 15 hours per week, making it ideal for those seeking flexibility or a part-time schedule.

Responsibilities

• Ensure a smooth overnight operation of the Front Office, maintaining a safe and welcoming environment

• Manage late check-ins, early check-outs, and all guest requests during the night shift

• Handle administrative tasks such as night auditing, reporting, and system updates accurately

• Respond to guest inquiries across phone, email, and face-to-face communication

• Maintain professional communication with guests and colleagues to ensure seamless service

• Monitor hotel security and safety procedures in line with brand standards

• Collaborate with housekeeping and other departments to prepare for the next day's operations

Essential Requirements

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Ability to work independently and remain calm during night shifts

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail

• Responsible and proactive mindset with a focus on guest experience

• Eligible to work in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in Front Office or night audit roles

• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)

• Basic accounting or reporting experience is an advantage
